set.body: Build deterministic atlas fixtures and parity checks against neuroatlas semantics: constructor invariants, ROI metadata, query exact/radius, transform plans, overlap metrics, reduce-atlas behavior, and non-contiguous IDs. Keep network-backed/live atlas checks optional. Likely paths: modules/atlas/shared/src/test, modules/atlas/jvm/src/test, tools/r-parity.
set.title: Atlas standard fixture and parity corpus
